pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. Matthews was inactive, the Warner replacement and a light box held Bijan to the 72-yard version while Allgeier took a dozen carries, and ATL trailed so the second half was Penix throwing. Tonges posted the 21-yard game because the unnamed backup locked onto McCaffrey and Bourne, Atlanta's 43% blitz turned into sacks, and the weeks 4-6 target spike was Purdy-specific. The stand-in medians were never a price, so there is no CLV to claim either. That counter is real but not stronger than Warner being out against a back at 317 yards on 49 carries, which is why Bijan stays a flagged strong read and Tonges stays a lean rather than a pass.
slip_story: One close-game story, not a shootout and not an under: ATL runs Bijan into a depleted SF front while SF, without Purdy, lives in the quick game so Tonges clears a below-role receiving line. Those two can hit together at 24-22.5. Do not add Bourne or London overs, a total under, or any TD. Candidates only; no bet placed.
